meta.name: ABLux — Putni dnevnik (Editorial Voyage)
meta.description: Warm editorial travel-journal world extracted from the approved local homepage (hero to closing section) and the GPT design comps in public/generated/concepts; extended to the whole public site (Papir light theme + Tinta dark theme) and to the admin (operate mode).
source_references: app/page.tsx, components/home-hero.tsx, components/ablux-home-motion.tsx, app/styles/home.css (.ablux-* classes, 2026-09; formerly app/globals.css)

color.palette_type: warm neutrals with split-complementary accents (gold vs teal and brick)

primary.role: Mastilo (ink): hero and feature grounds, dark theme ground, primary text, admin sidebar

accent.role: Zlato (gold, gradient to #B99146): primary CTA fill with ink text, italic emphasis word, stamps, active indicators

neutral.usage: paper steps for grounds and bands; #5C6662 for secondary text on #F8F4EA (5.4:1) and #EFE8DA (4.9:1); #0A2428 for dark cards; #06151A for text and ink grounds

semantic.warning: #C28A2C (ochre, only as a chip background with ink text)

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant; hero and feature panels invert to ink with paper text; gold only as filled buttons (ink text 8.2:1), large display italics, or #7D5E27 for small gold text on paper (5.5:1); no gold text smaller than 24px on paper

font_families.heading: EB Garamond (display serif, italic gold emphasis word). Replaced Cormorant Garamond in step 04: Cormorant draws detached floating carons on lowercase č ž š at weights 400-600. Line-height >= 1.1 with caron padding
font_families.body: Manrope (UI and body; tabular-nums for prices, dates, counts)
font_families.mono: none — ticket codes use Manrope 800 uppercase with 0.12em tracking

typography.font_style_notes: high-contrast old-style display serif against a humanist-geometric sans; Sora is removed; admin uses Manrope only (serif only in the logo wordmark)

spacing.section_rhythm: 96-128px between sections on desktop, 64-72px on mobile; more space above a heading than below; one dense section is followed by a quiet one

layout.grid_system: 12-column grid, asymmetric editorial compositions (e.g. 1 feature card at 44% + a 2x2 grid)
layout.alignment_tendency: mixed: left-aligned section heads and cards, centered process and closing sections

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px rgba(6,21,26,.12-.16); ticket notches (cut corners via mask) and perforation edges; dashed route lines
shape.divider_style: 1px hairlines in paper-2 tones; dashed gold/brick route lines between related elements

elevation.shadow_style: soft diffused, warm-tinted (ink at low alpha), never glowing
elevation.depth_cues: overlapping paper layers, the paper band under the hero, texture, ink/paper inversion

iconography.style: fine engraved line glyphs (custom SVG like the ticket glyphs) for brand moments; one UI icon set with consistent 1.5px stroke for the rest (lucide only; react-icons removed in step 15)
iconography.preferred_set: custom SVG glyphs + lucide-react (already installed) at strokeWidth 1.5

motion.entrance_pattern: fade-up 24-46px with blur(8px) to 0, stagger 70-90ms, triggered at 82-96% viewport
motion.philosophy: cinematic-calm: slow reveals, one signature scroll moment (hero becomes a postcard), route lines drawing on scroll, no bounce, no scroll hijacking elsewhere; prefers-reduced-motion disables all of it

components.button_style: primary: gold gradient fill #D5A54F→#B99146, ink text, radius 10px, soft gold shadow, :active translateY(1px); ghost on ink: 1px paper/40%; secondary on paper: paper fill + 1px ink/16%; text link with arrow
components.input_style: label above (overline style), paper field #FDFAF3, 1px ink/16%, radius 10px, 2px gold focus ring with offset; on ink: #0A2428 fields with paper text (booking bar)
components.card_style: ticket (notched corners, perforation divider, stamp block with route code), postcard (photo with white deckled border + stamp), route card (photo with ink gradient + brass number plate)
components.navigation_pattern: transparent over the hero, then paper (light) / ink (dark) at 82% with 12px blur; serif wordmark; mega menu for Ponude by category; sticky search pill 'Kuda putujete?' after the hero
components.modal_style: paper sheet, radius 16px, ink overlay 60%; bottom sheets on mobile
components.list_style: tables with 1px hairlines, zebra paper-2, tabular numerals; admin lists dense with row actions on hover and always visible on touch
components.component_notes: raise fidelity to the comps: notched ticket corners, brass number plates, stamp labels, dashed routes with red pins, compass rose — the current build is simpler than the comps

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a travel journal: postcards, boarding passes, stamps, routes drawn on an old map
aesthetic.era_influence: mid-century travel ephemera meets a contemporary editorial magazine

visual_language.ornamentation: decorative but restrained (stamps, perforations, routes, pins)
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: dark cinematic hero on top, light paper body, ink feature panels as punctuation
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element, then progressive reveal
visual_language.texture_usage: paper grain and faint cartographic lines as background only, never under small text

composition.flow_direction: Z-pattern guided down the page by a drawn route line
composition.negative_space_role: frames photography and gives the serif headlines air

imagery.photo_treatment: golden-hour cinematic realism, warm grade, left third falling into ink shadow for copy; real photos (vehicles, team, trips) get a warm grade and slow motion in code, never AI alteration
imagery.graphic_elements: stamps, perforations, dashed routes, map pins, compass rose, brass number plates
imagery.image_shape: notched ticket corners, deckled postcard borders, rounded 10-16px

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: image slow zoom 1.04, stamp rotates 2deg, card lifts with warm shadow
interaction_feel.loading_style: skeletons with a paper shimmer matching the final layout

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: suggest alternatives instead of 'no results' (nearby months, similar destinations, contact us)
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: clear and reassuring, says what to do next

overview.fallback_strategy: static AVIF posters and CSS reveals on prefers-reduced-motion, Save-Data, or low-end devices

background_effects.description: living postcard: 8 s seamless Veo loops of the hero scenes (static camera, natural motion only), crossfaded per ticket channel; paper texture elsewhere
background_effects.technology: <video muted playsinline loop preload=metadata> with AVIF poster, paused when off-screen

scroll_morphing.description: the hero scene shrinks into a postcard (white deckled border + stamp), tilts ~2deg and lands as the first route card; the booking bar docks into a sticky 'Kuda putujete?' pill under the nav

text_effects.description: headline lines rise with 80ms stagger; the gold italic word gets an underline draw

image_effects.description: inset clip reveal on enter, slow zoom on hover, Ken Burns on real photos

svg_animations.description: route lines drawing between sections, stamp press, ticket perforation 'tear' as the channel timer

visual_effects.composite_notes: One signature moment only (hero → postcard). Everything else is quiet reveals. Videos: desktop 1920x1080 <= 3 MB, mobile 720x1280 <= 1.5 MB; only the default channel loads a video on mobile, other channels use stills with slow zoom. Pause videos when off-screen. Real photos are never altered by AI.
